message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Mauritius takes sovereignty of the islands but the UK maintains an initial 99-year lease of Diego Garcia with an option of extension.", "reason": "The page directly confirms both the sovereignty transfer to Mauritius and the 99-year lease of Diego Garcia for the joint UK-US military base."}

parsed.note_claim: The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a 99-year lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Mauritius takes sovereignty of the islands but the UK maintains an initial 99-year lease of Diego Garcia with an option of extension.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms both the sovereignty transfer to Mauritius and the 99-year lease of Diego Garcia for the joint UK-US military base.
